data.title: Choose the correct answer for each question.
data.description: Practise advanced linking expressions for contrast, addition, cause, result, condition and qualification.
learningPoints: Use moreover and furthermore to add supporting information.
Use nevertheless, whereas and while to express contrast.
Use therefore, consequently and as a result for logical outcomes.
Use provided that and unless to express conditions.
Use despite/in spite of and although with the correct structures.
Choose linkers according to both meaning and grammar.

sections.explain: MOREOVER adds a further supporting point, often in formal writing.

words.word: The plan is affordable. Moreover, it can be implemented quickly.
The plan is affordable. Nevertheless, it can be implemented quickly as an additional point.
The plan is affordable moreover because it can be implemented quickly.

sections.explain: NEVERTHELESS introduces a contrast despite what has just been said.

words.word: The task was difficult. Nevertheless, we completed it on time.
The task was difficult. Therefore, we completed it on time despite the contrast.
The task was difficult nevertheless but we completed it on time.

sections.explain: WHEREAS contrasts two facts or situations within one sentence.

words.word: Tom prefers working alone, whereas Anna enjoys teamwork.
Tom prefers working alone, therefore Anna enjoys teamwork.
Tom prefers working alone, whereas but Anna enjoys teamwork.

sections.explain: CONSEQUENTLY introduces a result caused by the preceding situation.

words.word: Demand fell sharply. Consequently, production was reduced.
Demand fell sharply. Whereas, production was reduced.
Demand fell sharply consequently because production was reduced.

sections.explain: PROVIDED THAT means only if a condition is satisfied.

words.word: You can borrow the car provided that you return it by six.
You can borrow the car despite that you return it by six.
You can borrow the car provided you will return it by six only.
We won't finish on time unless everyone helps.
We won't finish on time unless everyone doesn't help.
We won't finish on time unless everyone will help.

sections.explain: IN ADDITION TO is followed by a noun or -ing form.

words.word: In addition to reducing costs, the change improved efficiency.
In addition to reduce costs, the change improved efficiency.
In addition that it reduced costs, the change improved efficiency.

sections.explain: DESPITE THE FACT THAT can be followed by a full clause.

words.word: Despite the fact that it was late, they continued working.
Despite it was late, they continued working.
Despite the fact of it was late, they continued working.

sections.explain: AS A RESULT introduces a consequence and is normally separated from the previous sentence.

words.word: The road was flooded. As a result, the event was cancelled.
The road was flooded. Although, the event was cancelled.
The road was flooded as a result because the event was cancelled.

sections.explain: ON THE OTHER HAND introduces a contrasting perspective.

words.word: Working from home is convenient. On the other hand, it can be isolating.
Working from home is convenient. In addition, it can be isolating as a contrast.
Working from home is convenient on the other hand but it can be isolating.
